messages:
Sam: Pinnacle Labs sent their security checklist and the netops team wants exact firewall entries they can drop into their ticket. They specifically asked: can we do PrivateLink, and will it give them stable IPs for allowlisting during the POC? Also: do we preserve client source IP?
Jo: Short answer: PrivateLink can be used and we can provide the endpoint ENI public IPs after we provision, but AWS can perform maintenance that may change underlying EIPs. For strict immutable IPs recommend peering or a short Dedicated/private deploy.
Ravi: Also flag: PrivateLink terminates at our ENI and we do NOT preserve the original client source IP in our backend logs for hosted PrivateLink. If they need src-IP preservation for their internal ACLs, peering or running Redwood in their account is required.
Claire: They said their proxy blocks SNI-based hostnames; they only accept IP allowlists. That increases provisioning time but still doable. We'll need to stand up the endpoint and then share the EIPs. 
Sam: Can we give a tiny firewall snippet they can paste to their change ticket? Keep it JSON-friendly.
Jo: One-line CMDB-friendly example (they'll replace with provided EIPs):
```json
{"name":"pinnacle->redwood-privatelink","dir":"egress","proto":"tcp","port":"443","dest":"<REPLACE_WITH_PROVIDED_EIP>","desc":"POC to Redwood PrivateLink endpoint"}
```
Ravi: If they can't accept any IP churn, call out the business risk. For most POCs customers accept a small IP-change window; for finance/legal regulated customers we push peering or dedicated.
Claire: Pricing note for security questionnaire: PrivateLink = AWS iface endpoint hourly + AWS data processing per GB + our connectivity surcharge (small); peering = no endpoint fee but possible cross-AZ transfer costs and more setup time. Include that as a single-line bullet.
Sam: Also include these minimal netops rules to allow path MTU and time sync if needed:
```
Allow TCP 443 -> <provided-eip-or-fqdn>
Allow ICMP type 3 (PMTUD)
Allow UDP 123 -> NTP (optional)
```
Jo: Action items: (1) confirm Pinnacle accepts post-provision EIPs, (2) infra to provision sandbox endpoint if they do, (3) security to fill in encryption/mTLS/logging bullets for questionnaire.
infra-bot: Created NET-9981 to provision sandbox PrivateLink in eu-west-1 for Pinnacle POC. ETA 72 hours.
Sam: Thanks team — I'll get back to Pinnacle with the snippet and ask them to confirm IP-only policy. If they push for src-IP preservation we'll propose short-term peering or a Dedicated eval. :thumbsup:
